lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: Stop! You're doing it all wrong!

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: Let me take a swing at this.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You think you can give a better speech than royalty?

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: Please! I've been conning these suckers for years!

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: Wait, they didn't hear that, did they?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: Good. Gotta keep that gas lit.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Alright. Mic's hot.

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: People of Earth!

lines.speaker: Earthling
lines.text: Wait, is that Mr. Satan?

lines.speaker: Earthling
lines.text: We love you, Satan!

lines.speaker: Earthlings
lines.text: Hail Satan! Hail Satan! Hail Satan!
HAIL SATAN!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I swear to God, I'd let that planet burn if it wasn't where I kept all my stuff.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What about your wife and kid?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I SAID MY STUFF!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, problem! It's still not enough!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, you should probably... you know?

lines.speaker: Hercule
lines.text: Oh, alright. But only one hand.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Holy shit!
